title: Wren and the Room
author: Kestrel Dunmore
blurb: Dominic Lockridge, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
